material_claim: Every node of a finite eager acyclic continuation fires exactly once and has a fixed free-algebra term.
limitations: Logical finite DAG only; no physical runtime progress claim.

material_claim: The propagated cross origin/readiness rows are exact worst-case timestamp differences, and output age is their maximum over data lineage.
limitations: Independent bounded delays and a bounded nonempty input domain.

material_claim: Exposed fixed segments compose by max-plus multiplication and uniform time rebasing preserves ages.
limitations: A standard max-plus baseline, not claimed as novel.

material_claim: Feasible potentials certify nonempty difference zones and negative cycles certify emptiness.
A closed DBM cell has a feasible column potential that attains its exact bound.
limitations: Single zone at a time; unions use an outer maximum.

material_claim: For fixed clock-oblivious source-complete continuations, entrywise profile order is exactly the universal freshness contextual order.
limitations: Fails for timestamp-branching contexts; payload metadata must agree.

material_claim: Any exact representation that answers every fixed-context threshold test on the declared n-port, n-origin bounded matrix family distinguishes all (K+1)^(n^2) profiles.
limitations: Information lower bound for exact representations under the stated threshold-test interface; not a lower bound for approximate or restricted-context abstractions.

material_claim: Opaque compound payloads quotient static fixed-context freshness by the per-port maximum of origin rows.
limitations: Only contexts unable to destructure or inspect payload timestamps.

material_claim: Birth-blind controllers that observe readiness/events/receipts are ordered exactly by readiness-support inclusion and conditional oldest-birth envelopes.
limitations: General theorem assumes the declared observer language; code validates finite one-decision instances.

material_claim: For one closed difference zone, conditional earliest source birth is a minimum of closed-row affine forms.
Single-zone adaptive refinement is decidable exactly by readiness DBM inclusion plus a per-payload closed-row cover.
limitations: No union-of-zones completeness claim; payloads are opaque free-algebra terms.

material_claim: If controllers observe every source birth, exact state-set inclusion replaces the birth-blind envelope quotient.
limitations: Boundary theorem, not a recommendation to expose physical timestamps.

material_claim: The prefix checker characterizes valid observed event/receipt prefixes of the finite eager semantics.
limitations: Assumes an exact logical observation; does not implement distributed snapshot acquisition.

material_claim: Conditioning and residualization preserve the exact future event/receipt/output observation set without splitting a difference zone.
finite_source_or_test: 9,308 prefix visits and 9,308 residual assignments; 1,225 distinct prefixes
limitations: Independent bounded edge delays; one boundary port per crossing message.

material_claim: Receipt-blind exact representation of a particular n-join cut by unions of difference zones needs exactly 2^n zones.
limitations: Lower bound is for unions of DBM zones, not arbitrary symbolic domains.

material_claim: A finite sequence of admitted logical updates preserves key terms and freshness deadlines and eventually emits all remaining keys after the last update.
limitations: Atomic logical installation; no mutable-state ownership or infinite-update guarantee.

material_claim: The four deterministic validation campaigns and 43-test suite have zero producer/replay/oracle discrepancies, and scientific outputs are stable across three distinct Python hash seeds.
finite_source_or_test: 43 tests; four complete campaign selections; three distinct PYTHONHASHSEED clean reruns
limitations: Finite bounded model validation; not real-system performance, independent implementation, or machine-checked metatheory.
